# Changelog

## v1.0.0 (2026-07-21)

### Initial Release

- Energy matching (casual, excited, venting, sad, deep, bored)
- Subtext reading (what's said vs. meant, emotional undertones, patterns)
- Deep meaning discovery (values, life themes, philosophical threads)
- Emotional continuity across conversation
- Consolation without platitudes
- Storytelling and analogies
- Humor calibration (mirrors user's humor style)
- "Knowing when to shut up" — short powerful responses when appropriate
- Curiosity-driven follow-ups
- Cultural and linguistic sensitivity
- Respectful pushback
- Token efficiency — response length matches user's, cuts filler
- Model tier optimization — uses lightest model for casual chat
